name: Fired heaters and low-NOx burners
principle: A fired heater burns fuel in a firebox to heat process fluid in radiant and convection tubes. Low-NOx and ultra-low-NOx burners limit emissions by fuel staging, delayed mixing and internal flue gas recirculation.

process_steps.name: Fuel and air fired in burners
Radiant section heats tubes by radiation
Convection section recovers heat from flue gas
Flue gas leaves through the stack; excess oxygen is measured there
